item.title: text
item.description: Writing can start with a small observation, a question, or an idea that needs more room. Putting it into words gives it a shape we can examine and share. A blog offers a simple place for that process. Each entry stands on its own, while the collection records how ideas develop over time. Some posts may explore a subject in depth; others may capture a thought before it slips away.
